name: Calendar integration
description: Adds Google Calendar and CalDAV accounts, event editing, reminders, and bar integration.
author: flathead
permissions: Connects to calendar providers configured by the user
Stores OAuth or CalDAV credentials in the user's Ambxst data directory
Sends desktop notifications for calendar reminders
Opens calendar event and meeting links in the default browser
Reads existing gcalcli credentials when the user imports them
Plays reminder sounds, including an optional audio file selected by the user
